verdict.rationale: Unstructured is a document-processing platform, so classifying and splitting multi-document packets is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence covers partitioning, per-page routing to partition strategies, chunking and schema-based extraction. None of it shows the product detecting document boundaries in a single upload, classifying each document, or returning separate per-document results. Per-page strategy routing and by-page or by-title chunking are not document classification or splitting, so the capability is unevidenced.
